# Helvety Image Upscaler

> Upscale PNG, JPEG, or WebP in your browser on your device. AI quality when supported, with sensible limits so tabs stay responsive. Image pixels are not uploaded to Helvety for processing in the normal flow; AI model weights may download once from Helvety-hosted storage. Engineered, designed and made in Switzerland.

## Canonical URL
- [Helvety Image Upscaler](https://helvety.com/image-upscaler): Main application route

## Crawling And Indexing
- The public image upscaler route is intended to be crawlable and indexable.
